# sigma_source_swap_policy (Resource)

Manages a Sigma source swap policy. `swaps_json` is polymorphic by `type` (`connection` or `deployment`). This resource uses a Sigma Beta API and may change without notice.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sigma_source_swap_policy" "example" {
  type               = "deployment"
  name               = "Swap warehouse"
  from_connection_id = "connection-id"
  swaps_json = jsonencode({
    toConnection = {
      swapType        = "attribute"
      userAttributeId = "user-attribute-id"
    }
    deploymentSwaps = []
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from_connection_id` (String) Connection ID to swap from.
- `name` (String) Source swap policy name.
- `swaps_json` (String) JSON swaps object accepted by the Sigma source swap policy API.
- `type` (String) Policy type: `connection` or `deployment`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Source swap policy ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env sh
terraform import sigma_source_swap_policy.example source-swap-policy-id
```
